items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And we had Hubert Laws, Jerome Richardson, Ray Brown, Tommy Flanagan, you know.

ctx.x: You know, it kind of moves around the room a little bit or something, you know. And I got -- after that I got used to it. Now it's just like eating duck soup. Because the last thing I did with Milt Jackson was a string date, you know. It came off very good. And we had Hubert Laws, Jerome Richardson, Ray Brown, Tommy Flanagan, you know. I always keep a few of the jazz tribe in there. You know. That's from whence I came.
How long did you know Erroll Garner?
